paper.title: A formal proof of the Kepler conjecture

thesis: The Kepler conjecture is certified by reducing the proof to formal logic plus three computational subclaims checked in HOL Light and Isabelle.

nodes.title: Can any congruent sphere packing beat FCC density?
nodes.body: Determine whether a packing of congruent balls in Euclidean three-space can exceed the density of the face-centered cubic packing.

nodes.title: No packing is denser than FCC
nodes.body: The face-centered cubic packing reaches the maximal possible density.

nodes.title: Use Marchal cells
nodes.body: The formalization replaced decomposition stars from the original proof with Marchal cells, whose geometry was better suited to formal proof.

nodes.title: Formalize the mathematical argument
nodes.body: Encode the proof in HOL Light and Isabelle, including the geometric and measure-theoretic foundations.

nodes.title: Verify nonlinear inequalities
nodes.body: Formally verify the nonlinear inequalities used by the local geometric estimates.

nodes.title: Inequality certificates checked
nodes.body: The nonlinear inequality verification completed in less than one day of computation.

nodes.title: Enumerate tame plane graphs
nodes.body: Exhaustively classify the combinatorial plane graphs that remain possible counterexample configurations.

nodes.title: Graph classification exhausted
nodes.body: The formal enumeration eliminated graph types outside the tame classification.

nodes.title: Check linear programs
nodes.body: Solve and formally certify thousands of linear programs associated with the remaining tame graphs.

nodes.title: Hardest computation certified
nodes.body: The linear-program verification was the most expensive computational subclaim.

nodes.title: End-to-end theorem checked
nodes.body: All parts of the proof were formalized and checked by proof assistants; formalization also corrected hundreds of small errors in the original presentation.

openQuestions: The paper certifies the theorem, but this reconstruction does not include machine-checkable proof objects beyond the downloaded article.
